column3: “It was heard by” is rendered “it was reported to.”
“From your heart” is rendered “in your own mind.”
“Saying” is rendered “thinking,” and “their hands will drop” as “they will become discouraged.” NASB supplies “O God.”
“Shut up” is rendered “confined at home”; the meaning of the Hebrew word here is uncertain.
“And he will live” is rendered “to save his life.”
“There! God had not sent him” is rendered “surely God had not sent him”; NASB supplies “because.”
“A bad name” is rendered “an evil report.”
“His works” is rendered “these works of theirs.”
The Hebrew verb can be read “were afraid” or “saw”; NASB has “saw it.” “They fell exceedingly in their own eyes” is rendered “they lost their confidence.”
“Were multiplying letters” is rendered “many letters went.”
“Lords of oath” is rendered “bound by oath.”
